course_name_original: Metodología para la elaboración, presentación y gestión de trabajos técnicos
course_name_en: Methodology for the preparation, presentation, and management of technical works

learning_outcomes.text: Handling methods, techniques, and tools for organizing and managing technical documents other than engineering projects.
Skill in managing information and communication systems in the industrial field.
Skills to adequately communicate knowledge, procedures, results, and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.

syllabus_topics: Personal knowledge management: PKM, knowledge graphs
Editing and composition of documentation. Advanced use of common text editors.
Introduction to the free LaTeX editor.
Written documentation formats: Norms and writing styles.
Writing and elaboration of scientific-technical documents.
Writing and elaboration of scientific-technical documents.
Elements to consider in the defense of academic works.
assessment_rules: For continuous evaluation, a minimum grade of 5 out of 10 is required for each item; otherwise, the student must retake the failed item. For global evaluation, the student can pass by completing a scientific-technical document with LaTeX (25%), a scientific-technical document with MS Word (25%), a knowledge manager structure (20%), and an oral presentation (30%). Each global evaluation component also requires a minimum grade of 5 out of 10, with re-examination for failed items. Unethical behavior (copying, plagiarism, unauthorized electronic device use) will result in a global failing grade of 0.0 for the academic year.
